original.statement: A new optional-looking field spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID was added to the cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer schema.

decision.reason: The validator compared the two CRD artifacts. It found that spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID is in the cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer schema of the target release [ev-60054fcf0986] but not of the earlier one [ev-84061d76ea1b]. That confirms the subject and an "added" change. Nothing shows the change is specific to one API version, so the proposed subject is right to leave out version.
